app_faq_free_q: How do I know if a court is free?
app_faq_free_a: Check the status badge on the card, on the map or in the court details. Available (blue) means free now, In use (red) means there is a match at this time and Closed (gray) means it is outside opening hours. The badge also shows until when the status lasts.
app_faq_closed_q: Why does a court show as Closed?
app_faq_closed_a: It may be outside opening hours, on a day it doesn't open, or closed by the person in charge. When the opening hours haven't been provided yet, the court also shows as closed.
app_faq_map_q: Why don't some courts show on the map?
app_faq_map_a: Only courts whose address has been located go on the map. The others still show in the {{search}} tab.
app_faq_rent_q: How do I rent a court?
app_faq_rent_a: In the court details, tap “{{talk}}” to arrange the time and payment on WhatsApp. Then the person in charge schedules the match on the Kolae website and the court shows as In use at that time.
app_faq_match_q: Can I create a match in the app?
app_faq_match_a: No. Matches are scheduled on the website by the person in charge of the court, for whoever rented the time. In the app you follow the status and the day's schedule.
app_faq_owner_q: I have a court. How do I add it to Kolae?
app_faq_owner_a: Register your CNPJ (Brazilian business ID) on the Kolae website. Your account becomes a court manager account, and there you add courts, opening hours and matches.
app_faq_password_q: I forgot my password. What now?
app_faq_password_a: On the sign-in screen, tap “{{forgot}}” and enter your email. The link to create a new password arrives within a few minutes. Also check your spam folder.
app_faq_birthdate_q: Why can't I change my date of birth?
app_faq_birthdate_a: To keep the minimum age rule of 18, the date of birth can't be changed after sign-up.
app_faq_appearance_q: How do I make the text bigger or change the colors?
app_faq_appearance_a: Go to {{menu}} › {{settings}} and open {{appearance}}. There you pick the color, light or dark mode, text size, the easy-reading font and whether to reduce animations.
app_faq_location_q: Why does the app ask for my location?
app_faq_location_a: To show courts near you and how far each one is. You can turn it off anytime in {{general}} › {{location}}.
